summary: # ** COURT-I ** ## ## ** Dated: 4 ** **th** ** April, 2016 ** ## ## ## Learned counsel for the appellant, on instructions, submits that the matter has become infructuous. title: Jharkhand State Electricity Board. Versus Central Electricity Regulatory Commission & Anr.
